fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-29bf50db at 13ac9726: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes; TestAutonomyDeclaration parses autonomous = true (all four stages auto), autonomous = false (all owner), a partial [autonomy] table (plan owner, ship auto, accept/signoff undeclared) and no declaration (none), and Parse and Validate both refuse both forms ('autonomous and [autonomy] are both set'), an unknown stage ('autonomy.build: unknown stage') and a bad value ('autonomy.ship: maybe is not a mode') plus a non-boolean autonomous. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(workflow-check|workflow-stage-autonomy|plan-milestone-workflow) passes; workflow-check.txtar shows rhiza workflow check exiting non-zero with the bad-value and both-forms messages. By hand with a scratch build, files in a scratch repo's .rhiza/workflows checked by name gave the unknown-stage, both-forms and bad-value refusals naming the key (exit 1) and a partial table valid (exit 0). Read parseAutonomy in internal/workflow/workflow.go and its call from Parse and check.go; the leaf commit itself adds only model records, the code having landed earlier in this change set.
